bio.text: Mark Teixeira is the Republican nominee for Texas's open 21st Congressional District in the November 2026 election, having won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary with more than 61% of the vote in a field of more than a dozen candidates.

Teixeira is a former Major League Baseball first baseman who played for the Texas Rangers and New York Yankees during a 14-season career that included three All-Star selections and a 2009 World Series title with the Yankees.
The Associated Press reported that Teixeira grew up in Severna Park and that he and his family moved back to Texas in 2021 after he retired from baseball.
